subject: Insurance
title: Connected Cars and Real-Time Pricing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Connected Cars and Real-Time Pricing.

hook.text: Modern cars transmit real-time data: location, speed, braking patterns, and miles driven.

buildup.text: Instead of a fixed annual premium, imagine dynamic pricing: lower rates on safe highways.

discovery.text: Some insurers already adjust rates monthly based on telematics data.

twist.text: General Motors sold driver data to LexisNexis, which affected customers' insurance rates.

climax.text: Real-time pricing sounds precise, but leaked driving data can become a permanent rating file.

quiz.question: What is the main privacy concern with connected car insurance?
options: Cars transmit real-time driving data that affects insurance rates
